purpose: R-A① step 2 (register the reviewed G1/G2 broker method drafts into the production registry data/sdk/capability-broker-methods-v1.json) is mechanically blocked by frozen v1 ceilings/vocabularies. Clamp-translating instead of revising would distort approved contracts (4 MiB chunks cannot pass a 1 MiB response cap; host-owned dialog dwell cannot pass a 10 s timeout). This draft proposes the minimal schema revision set so registration becomes byte-faithful. Approval of THIS draft is a separate review decision from R-A①; nothing in revisions below flips any availability or enables any runtime behavior.
notes: Battery rows are untouched in every revision: device.battery.getState/refresh stay enabled in preview and production, and the bundle production-battery-broker.global.js behavior is unchanged (defaultDecision deny + unknownMethods deny still deny everything not implemented).

The alternative (clamp) was measured and rejected: registering readChunk with a 1 MiB response cap would shrink the approved chunk size from 4 MiB to ~760 KiB; clamping begin/commit/requestAssist timeouts to 10 s would force split-request workarounds not present in any reviewed design. Distortion is worse than a reviewed ceiling raise.

Registry edition itself (methods entries, events entry, exclusion split, provenance note) happens AFTER this revision is approved, in a follow-up commit that also regenerates tools/build-developer-studio-validator.mjs outputs and extends tests/capability-broker-contract-smoke.mjs.

schemaRevisions.rationale: reviewed drafts use hyphenated capability segments; the frozen v1 pattern admits only alnum segments (battery.status). Hyphenated segments must be admitted or the four reviewed runtime capabilities cannot register. Battery values unaffected.

the reviewed write-session family lives under one namespace with chained members (device.storage.writeSession.begin); the schema's publicMember admits a single token. Dotted members must be admitted or five of the nine reviewed methods cannot register. Facade construction stays publicNamespace + '.' + publicMember (battery rows unaffected: getState/refresh remain single tokens).

schemaRevisions.shapeRationale: modeled on the actual reviewed event entries (the ai draft's events[0] carries no availability/currentStatus/sanitization fields; its governance text lives in a notes array). Event enablement is decided by the per-method runtime review of the channel that carries it - it is NOT a registry availability field.
schemaRevisions.note: The wire-level event envelope stays frozen (event.type enum snapshot.update/capability.change unchanged); V7 only gives event CONTRACTS a registry home. The runtime event-channel extension for assist.received is a per-method review item, not implied by registration.

schemaRevisions.rationale: edition provenance on the production registry (permissions-v1.json precedent already carries a notes array); without it the registry cannot contain the review-decision note that accompanies the edition

explicitlyNotInThisRevision: No availability flip: no method moves toward enabled; preview audit-mode enablement is a later, per-batch review.
No runtime/broker code change (production-battery-broker and developer-studio preview brokers untouched).
No facade generation (d.ts edit stays deferred per repo rule 4); registered candidates are still invisible to sandboxes until facade lands per-method.
validationChecks: Every revision path (V1-V4, V6, and each path in V5) exists in the base schema JSON with the stated current shape (raise/append/widen pre-checked mechanically before human review).
V7/V8 designs are legal JSON Schema 2020-12 fragments reused from existing $defs references.
Every affectedMethod listed in V1-V6 appears in one of the two method drafts with the cited conflicting value.
Battery registry rows are not touched by any revision (mechanically verified against the base file before/after).

A simulated post-revision registry (battery rows + the nine candidate methods + event + split exclusions + notes) validates clean against the revised schema (in-memory simulation in the round checker, before any production file is touched).
